title: 第1章 来到异世第2章 杂役弟子
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
夜色昏沉，寒冷的清风拍打着窗户，嘎吱作响。
还算暖和的房间里，大通铺上躺着几个营养不良的少年，正呼呼大睡。
有节奏的打鼾声，偶尔响起的梦话，同时房间弥漫着阵阵脚臭的味道，让林潜久久无法入睡。
林潜双手垫在头下，双眼呆呆的盯着屋顶，表情点着忧伤。
“这梦怎么还不醒，要怎么才能回去？”
林潜低声自语，泪水从眼角滑落，在苍白瘦小的脸颊留下泪痕。
林潜不是这个世界的人。
他原本是地球上一名普普通通的打工仔，做着朝九晚五的工作。
每天上班准时打卡，同时准时下班，绝不加班。
拿着够自己潇洒的工资。
下班要么和朋友喝酒撸串，要么开黑玩游戏，要么健身房撸铁，偶尔与朋友聊聊少儿不宜的话题。
那天是周五，下班回到家。
他先是和朋友开黑到半夜，然后躺在床上熬夜看小说，结果一觉醒来就出现在类似古代的陌生县城里。
当时他正躺在街边房屋墙角，双眼紧闭。
身下垫着不知道从哪捡来的破席子，双手紧紧抱着肚子。
一阵凉风吹来，林潜身体不自觉的打了个哆嗦，向前一扑，猛然坐了起来。
双眼带着迷茫，环顾四周。
窄巷纵横，青石板铺就的街道；建筑是传统的木结构构成，错落有致，别具一格，像是置身于古城。
一连串陌生记忆从脑海深处翻出，林潜知道他穿越了，并且还穿越成了一名乞丐。
林潜并没有慌张，反而他还是有些激动的。

他觉得他的好运来了，该轮到他在这个世界大展拳脚，呼风唤雨了。
林潜作为小说爱好者，知道穿越者都会带有金手指的，看过小说的都知道，这已经是一个常识了。
虽然起点是乞丐不代表以后成就低嘛。
西市已经开市了，街上来来往往的行人，好不热闹。
而在西市的一角站着一位小乞丐，神色激动，嘴里念念有词，时不时还挥舞着手臂。
“系统在吗？喂喂，系统。”
“系统，我要打卡，签到。”
“老爷爷？老神仙？在不在？”
折腾了小一会后，林潜呼吸变得急促，眼神带着慌乱。
手在身上不停的乱摸，看有没有随自己一起穿越过来的物件，把身上披着的破烂衣服翻遍了，毛都没找到一个。
一位妇女牵着小孩路过。
content_en:
The night was gloomy, and the cold breeze slapped the windows, making a creaking sound.
In the relatively warm room, several malnourished teenagers were lying on the big bunk, sleeping soundly.
Rhythmic snoring, occasional sleep talking, and the smell of foot odor permeating the room kept Lin Qian unable to fall asleep for a long time.
Lin Qian put his hands under his head and stared blankly at the roof with a sad expression.
"Why don't you wake up from this dream? How can I go back?"
Lin Qian whispered to himself, tears falling from the corners of his eyes, leaving tear stains on his pale and thin cheeks.
Lin Qian is not from this world.
He was originally an ordinary wage earner on earth, working a nine-to-five job.
Punch in on time every day and get off work on time, and never work overtime.
Earn a salary that is comfortable enough for you.
下班要么和朋友喝酒撸串，要么开黑玩游戏，要么健身房撸铁，偶尔与朋友聊聊少儿不宜的话题。
It was Friday, I got home from get off work.
He first went dark with his friends until midnight, and then stayed up late in bed reading novels. As a result, when he woke up, he appeared in a strange county similar to ancient times.
At that time, he was lying in the corner of the house on the street, with his eyes closed.
There was a tattered mat picked up from somewhere under her body, and she held her belly tightly with both hands.
A gust of cool wind blew, and Lin Qian shivered unconsciously, jumped forward, and sat up suddenly.
With confused eyes, he looked around.
There are narrow alleys and streets paved with bluestone slabs; the buildings are made of traditional wooden structures, well-proportioned and unique, making you feel like you are in an ancient city.
A series of strange memories emerged from the depths of his mind, and Lin Qian knew that he had traveled through time, and had become a beggar.
Lin Qian didn't panic. Instead, he was a little excited.
He felt that his good luck had come, and it was his turn to show off his talents in this world and make waves.
As a lover of novels, Lin Qian knew that time travelers would have golden fingers. Everyone who had read novels knew that this was already common sense.
Just because you started out as a beggar doesn't mean your future achievements will be low.
The West Market has opened, and the streets are very lively with pedestrians coming and going.
And in the corner of the West Market stood a little beggar, with an excited expression, mumbling words, and waving his arms from time to time.
"Is the system here? Hello, system."
"System, I want to clock in and sign in."
"Grandpa? Old god? Are you here?"
After struggling for a while, Lin Qian's breathing became rapid and his eyes were panicked.
His hands kept stroking around his body to see if there were any objects that had traveled through time with him. He rummaged through the tattered clothes he was wearing, but Mao couldn't find any of them.
A woman passed by holding a child.
